module: Flowgraph node 'Wait' (logic category, behaviour duration+once). When the flow arrives, waits 'duration' seconds (3 by default) before outputting flow; requires a continuous input flow. Pin 'reset' (impulse), 'useDtSim' (uses dtSim instead of dtReal). Outputs: flow (after the wait) and impulse 'impulse' only once.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets timer and running to zero.

_onDeserialized.desc: Migrates the old field 'duration' to the hard-coded pin 'duration'.

updateTimer.desc: If running, adds dtSim or dtReal to the timer; at the end stops and emits the impulse.

work.desc: Handles flow/reset, calls updateTimer; flow = (timer >= duration) AND input flow.
